tasks.description:
Complete phase 1: Parser grammar alignment (canonical format + backward compatibility)

REVIEW FAIL (uat): US-001 fenced-bash Done-When compiles to an executable gate — Expected: Phase 1 "Done When" cmd 3 `jq -r '.phases[2].tasks[].gateScript' specs/_fixtures/plan-format/.gwrk/tasks.json | grep -q 'make test:db'` exits 0, cmd 4 `! jq ... | grep -q '^echo "Phase'` exits 0 as a real guard, and §9 VR-004's jq assertions verify against a committed fixture. Actual: `specs/_fixtures/plan-format/.gwrk/tasks.json` is not committed (only plan.md/plan-legacy.md/plan-stub.md are), so cmd 3 exits 1 (file not found) and cmd 4 passes only vacuously — grep matches nothing because the file is absent, a false-green in the exact class this feature exists to prevent, and VR-004 is unverifiable against committed state. Note: the behavior is correct — running the aligned parser over specs/_fixtures/plan-format/plan.md materializes phase[2] gate `make dev:up && make db:migrate && make test:db` verbatim (both jq checks then pass), and all 25 vitest cases (TR-001..TR-008, incl. the -t "fenced-bash Done-When" acceptance test) are green. Only the committed jq-based acceptance artifact is missing. See spec.md > US-001 Acceptance Scenario 1 (bullet 2) and §9 VR-004. Fix: commit `specs/_fixtures/plan-format/.gwrk/tasks.json` generated by the aligned parser (planToTasks over the fixture plan.md) so Done-When cmd 3/4 and VR-004 execute against committed state; OR amend plan.md Phase-1 Done-When + spec §9 VR-004 to a temp-dir generation step that matches the vitest temp-dir design (which deliberately avoids writing .gwrk/tasks.json into the repo). The Done-When as written is not executable against the committed repository — reconcile the two.
